title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reading.body:
An AI image generation system was deployed without controls to prevent its use in creating non-consensual intimate imagery. A man obtained photographs of a woman from her private social media accounts and used the system to generate sexually explicit images of her, then distributed them across multiple platforms using anonymous accounts and sent threatening messages. The deployment failure was the absence of any check on what the system was being used to create or who was using it.

The incident shows a model applied outside the conditions it should operate in: creating sexual content depicting a real person without consent. What would have caught this before distribution was either a content filter that blocks non-consensual intimate imagery, or a requirement that users verify their identity and agree to terms of service that prohibit such use. It is not established what safeguards, if any, the AI system had built in.

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for creating and spreading sexually explicit artificial intelligence-generated images of a college acquaintance. Bansal obtained photographs from the woman's private social media accounts and used AI technology to generate obscene morphed images. He then distributed the content through multiple fake social media accounts, including Instagram and Discord, while using numerous Gmail addresses to hide his identity and send threatening messages to the victim.

Police discovered the crime after the 22-year-old woman filed a complaint at the Cyber Police Station in North Delhi. During their investigation, officers analyzed digital footprints and traced connections between the fake accounts. Bansal admitted during questioning that he knew the victim from college and had developed personal resentment toward her following repeated conflicts. He also revealed that after he initially uploaded the content, other unknown users created additional explicit material that he subsequently reposted. Police recovered a mobile phone, two SIM cards, and other digital evidence related to the case, with investigations continuing.
